segments.name: one reportable segment
segments.evidence: As such, the Company has determined that it operates in one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The company earns fees from merchants based on transaction size and charges consumers delivery and service fees per transaction, plus advertising.
revenueModel.evidence: We typically earn a fee from merchants for the services we provide based on the size of each transaction.

changes.text: In 2025 the company acquired Deliveroo, adding the Deliveroo Marketplace to its offerings.
changes.evidence: In connection with the acquisition of Deliveroo, the Company entered into a deal-contingent foreign exchange forward transaction with Bank of America, N.A.
